sentences.zh: 天文下

translations.literal: Astronomy, Part Two

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：天文設象，宜備內外兩宮，但災之所躔，不必徧行景緯，五星精晷與二曜而爲七，妖祥是主，歷數攸司，蓋有殊於列宿也。

translations.literal: The historians say: Astronomy sets forth images and ought to include both the inner and outer palaces; yet where calamities lodge, they need not traverse every astral girdle and lodge. The five stars' essences and gnomon-shadow measures join with the two luminaries to make seven; inauspicious and auspicious omens are their domain, and the calendar's numbers their charge—thus they differ essentially from the fixed lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The compiler remarks: Heaven's signs should chart both the inner and outer celestial palaces—yet disasters need not run through every girdle and lodge. With the five planets' motions and the sun and moon, seven bodies rule fortune and misfortune and hold the calendar's numbers—quite apart from the ordinary lodges.

sentences.zh: 若北辰不移，據在杠軸，衆星動流，實繫天體，五星從伏，非關二義，故徐顯思以五星爲非星，虞喜論之詳矣。

translations.literal: If the North Pole star does not move, resting on the crossbeam and pivot, the myriad stars move and flow—all truly bound to the celestial body. The five stars' accompanying motion and hiding have nothing to do with the two luminaries' paired meaning; hence Xu Xiansi held the five stars were not stars, and Yu Xi's discourse on it was detailed.
translations.idiomatic: The pole star stands fixed on heaven's axis while the myriad stars wheel around the sky itself. The five planets' retrograde and direct motion has nothing to do with sun and moon—so Xu Xiansi argued they were not true stars, as Yu Xi explained at length.

translations.literal: Year 9, fourth month, on guiwei, Venus traveled its cycle; at evening it was seen in the west, rapidly passing one degree through the Three Stars lodge; clouds had been frequent of late; by jichou the sky cleared; it was already seen north of the sun, at the northwest corner; at dusk the lodge stars were not visible—thus it had appeared before completing its cycle.

Weather had been cloudy; by jichou the skies cleared. It was already visible north of the sun, at the northwest corner; at thin dusk the lodge stars could not be seen—counted as appearing before its cycle was complete.

translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yichou day: Venus, traveling in train, stood eight cun east of the great star of Chariot-and-Drum, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月戊辰，太白從行在歲星西北六寸，爲犯，在奎度。

translations.literal: Year 11, first month, on wuchen, Venus traveling in train stood six cun northwest of Jupiter, an encroachment, in the Stride degree.
translations.idiomatic: Year 11, first month, wuchen day: Venus, traveling in train, stood six cun northwest of Jupiter in the Stride mansion degree, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，太白從行東井北轅西頭第一星東北一尺，爲犯。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingchou, Venus traveling in train stood one chi northeast of the first star at the western head of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingchou day: Venus, traveling in train, stood one chi northeast of the first star at the western end of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 四月戊子，太白在五諸侯東第二星西北六寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on wuzi, Venus stood six cun northwest of the second star east of the Five Marquises, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuzi day: Venus stood six cun northwest of the second star east of the Five Marquises, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太白從行入輿鬼，在東北星西南四寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Venus traveling in train entered Chariot and Ghost, four cun southwest of the northeastern star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Xinchou day: Venus, traveling in train, entered Chariot and Ghost four cun southwest of the northeastern star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，太白晝見當午，名爲經天。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wuwu, Venus was visible in daylight at the noon mark—termed crossing heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuwu day: Venus was visible in daylight at noon—called a meridian crossing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太白從行入軒轅大星北一尺二寸，無所犯。

translations.literal: On guihai, Venus traveling in train passed one chi two cun north of the great star of Chariot-and-Drum, without encroaching on anything.
translations.idiomatic: Guihai day: Venus, traveling in train, passed one chi two cun north of the great star of Chariot-and-Drum without encroaching on anything.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，太白晝見當午上。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiyou, Venus was visible in daylight above the noon mark.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiyou day: Venus was visible in daylight above noon.

sentences.zh: 十月丙戌，太白行在進賢星西南四寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on bingxu, Venus traveled, standing four cun southwest of the Advancement of the Worthy star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingxu day: Venus stood four cun southwest of the Advancement of the Worthy star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，太白從行入氐。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuxu, Venus traveling in train entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuxu day: Venus, traveling in train, entered Di.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太白從行在楗閉星西北六寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Venus traveling in train stood six cun northwest of the Door-bar and Lock star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao day: Venus, traveling in train, stood six cun northwest of Door-bar and Lock, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，太白從行在南斗第六星東南一尺，爲犯。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renchen, Venus traveling in train stood one chi southeast of the sixth star of the Southern Dipper, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renchen day: Venus, traveling in train, stood one chi southeast of the Southern Dipper's sixth star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太白從行在西建東星西南一尺，爲犯。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Venus traveling in train stood one chi southwest of the east star of Western Establishment, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Xinchou day: Venus, traveling in train, stood one chi southwest of Western Establishment's east star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 建元元年五月己未，熒惑犯太微西蕃上將，又犯東蕃上將。

translations.literal: Jianyuan year 1, fifth month, on jiwei, Mars transgressed the Senior General of the Supreme Palace western rampart, and also transgressed the Senior General of the eastern rampart.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyuan 1, fifth month, jiwei day: Mars infringed on the Supreme Palace western rampart Senior General and also on the eastern rampart Senior General.

sentences.zh: 二年十月辛酉，熒惑守太微。

translations.literal: Year 2, tenth month, on xinyou, Mars held the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyuan 2, tenth month, xinyou day: Mars held the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 四年六月戊子，熒惑從行入東井，無所犯。

translations.literal: Year 4, sixth month, on wuzi, Mars traveling in train entered the Eastern Well, without encroaching on anything.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyuan 4, sixth month, wuzi day: Mars, traveling in train, entered the Eastern Well without encroaching on anything.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，熒惑在東井度，形色小而黃黑不明。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Mars was in the Eastern Well degree; its form and color were small, yellow-black, and not bright.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxu day: Mars stood in the Eastern Well degree, small in form and color, dull yellow-black.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，熒惑太白同在東井度。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Mars and Venus were together in the Eastern Well degree.
translations.idiomatic: Dingchou day: Mars and Venus were together in the Eastern Well degree.

sentences.zh: 七月甲戌，熒惑從行入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on jiaxu, Mars traveling in train entered Chariot and Ghost, transgressing the Accumulated Corpse.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiaxu day: Mars, traveling in train, entered Chariot and Ghost and infringed on the Accumulated Corpse.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，熒惑從行犯太微西蕃上將星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on guiwei, Mars traveling in train transgressed the Senior General star of the Supreme Palace western rampart.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guiwei day: Mars, traveling in train, infringed on the Supreme Palace western rampart Senior General star.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，熒惑從入太微。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Mars traveling entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Bingxu day: Mars, traveling in train, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，熒惑從行在太微，犯右執法。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingchen, Mars traveling in train was in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, transgressing the Right Director of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingchen day: Mars, traveling in train, was in the Supreme Palace Enclosure and infringed on the Right Director of Justice.

sentences.zh: 永明元年正月己亥，熒惑逆犯上相。

translations.literal: Yongming year 1, first month, on jihai, Mars in retrograde transgressed the Upper Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yongming 1, first month, jihai day: Mars, moving retrograde, infringed on the Upper Minister.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，熒惑守角。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Mars stationed at the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Mars held the Horn.

sentences.zh: 庚子，熒惑逆入太微。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure in retrograde.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Mars entered Taiwei in retrograde.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，熒惑守太白。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingmao, Mars stationed at Venus.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, Mars held Venus.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，熒惑從犯亢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wushen, Mars followed and encroached upon the Neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wushen, Mars followed and encroached upon the Neck.

sentences.zh: 己巳，熒惑從行犯氐東南星。

translations.literal: On jisi, Mars followed in travel and encroached upon Di's southeastern star.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Mars passed in company and encroached upon Di's southeastern star.

sentences.zh: 七月戊寅，熒惑填星同在氐度。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on wuyin, Mars and Saturn shared the Di degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuyin, Mars and Saturn shared the Di degree.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，熒惑行犯房北頭第二星。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Mars traveled and encroached upon the second star at Room's northern head.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Mars encroached upon the second star at Room's northern head.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，熒惑從行犯天江。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yichou, Mars followed in travel and encroached upon the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou, Mars passed in company and encroached upon the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，熒惑犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Mars encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Mars encroached upon the Southern Dipper's fifth star.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，熒惑入羽林。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen, Mars entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, Mars entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 二年八月庚午，熒惑犯太微西蕃上將。

translations.literal: Year 2, eighth month, on gengwu, Mars encroached upon the supreme general of Taiwei's western rampart.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 2, on gengwu, Mars encroached upon the supreme general of Taiwei's western rampart.

sentences.zh: 癸未，熒惑犯太微右執法。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Mars encroached upon Taiwei's Right Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Mars encroached upon Taiwei's Right Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，熒惑犯太微右執法。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Mars encroached upon Taiwei's Right Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Mars encroached upon Taiwei's Right Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 十月庚申，熒惑犯進賢。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on gengshen, Mars encroached upon Advance Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengshen, Mars encroached upon Advance Worthies.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，熒惑犯亢南第二星。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renchen, Mars encroached upon the second star at the south of the Neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Mars encroached upon the Neck's second southern star.

sentences.zh: 丙申，熒惑犯亢南星。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Mars encroached upon the Neck's southern star.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Mars encroached upon the Neck's southern star.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yimao, Mars entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, Mars entered Di.

sentences.zh: 三年二月乙卯，熒惑在房北頭第一星西北一尺，徘徊守房。

translations.literal: Year 3, second month, on yimao, Mars was one chi northwest of the first star at Room's northern head, lingering and holding Room.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 3, on yimao, Mars stood one chi northwest of the first star at Room's northern head, lingering and holding Room.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌，熒惑犯。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on wuxu, Mars encroached.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuxu, Mars made an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，熒惑犯房。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yihai, Mars encroached upon Room.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, Mars encroached upon Room.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，熒惑犯天江南頭第二星。

translations.literal: On guihai, Mars encroached upon the second star at the southern head of the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Mars encroached upon the second star at the southern head of the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，熒惑犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingsi, Mars encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi, Mars encroached upon the Southern Dipper's fifth star.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，熒惑從行入羽林。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingxu, Mars followed in travel and entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, Mars passed in company into the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 四年八月戊辰，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month, on wuchen, Mars entered Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 4, on wuchen, Mars entered Taiwei.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，熒惑犯太微右執法。

translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Mars encroached upon Taiwei's Right Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 戊子，熒惑在太微。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Mars was in Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Mars stood in Taiwei.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wushen, Mars encroached upon Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen, Mars encroached upon Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 己酉，熒惑犯歲星，芒角相接。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Mars encroached upon Jupiter; rays and horns met.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Mars encroached upon Jupiter, their rays and horns touching.

sentences.zh: 十月丁丑，熒惑犯亢南頭第一星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on dingchou, Mars encroached upon the first star at the south head of the Neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingchou, Mars encroached upon the first star at the Neck's southern head.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，熒惑犯氐西南星。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengyin, Mars encroached upon Di's southwestern star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, Mars encroached upon Di's southwestern star.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，熒惑犯房北頭第一星。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiwei, Mars encroached upon the first star at Room's northern head.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, Mars encroached upon the first star at Room's northern head.

sentences.zh: 庚申，熒惑入房北犯鉤鈐星。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Mars entered north of Room and encroached upon the Hook and Sickle.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Mars entered north of Room and encroached upon the Hook and Sickle.

sentences.zh: 五年二月乙亥，熒惑填星同在南斗度，爲合宿。

translations.literal: Year 5, second month, on yihai, Mars and Saturn shared the Southern Dipper degree, forming conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 5, on yihai, Mars and Saturn shared the Southern Dipper degree in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，熒惑從行在哭星東，相去半寸。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yiwei, Mars followed in travel east of the Wailing Star, half a cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiwei, Mars passed in company east of the Wailing Star, half a cun away.

sentences.zh: 六年四月癸丑，熒惑伏在參度，去太白二尺五寸，辰星去太白五尺，三星爲合宿。

translations.literal: Year 6, fourth month, on guichou, Mars was concealed at the Shen degree, two chi five cun from Venus; Mercury stood five chi from Venus—the three stars forming conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 6, on guichou, Mars lay concealed at the Shen degree two chi five cun from Venus; Mercury stood five chi from Venus—the three stars in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，熒惑在辰星東南二尺五寸，俱從行，入東井曠中，無所犯。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Mars was two chi five cun southeast of Mercury; both followed in travel and entered the Eastern Well open center, encroaching upon nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Mars stood two chi five cun southeast of Mercury; both passed in company into the Eastern Well open center without encroaching on any star.

sentences.zh: 閏四月丁丑，熒惑從行在氐西南星北七寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, on dingchou, Mars followed in travel seven cun north of Di's southwestern star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on dingchou, Mars passed in company seven cun north of Di's southwestern star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 己卯，熒惑從行入氐，無所犯。

translations.literal: On jimao, Mars followed in travel and entered Di, encroaching upon nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Mars passed in company into Di without encroaching on any star.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，熒惑從行在房北頭第一上將右驂星南六寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: On yisi, Mars followed in travel six cun south of the right outrigger star of the first star at Room's northern head, the senior general—an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Mars passed in company six cun south of the right outrigger of the first star at Room's northern head, the senior general—an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 又在鉤鈐星西北五寸。

translations.literal: It was also five cun northwest of the Hook and Sickle.
translations.idiomatic: It also stood five cun northwest of the Hook and Sickle.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，熒惑從行在歲星西，相去四尺，同在尾度，爲合宿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingyin, Mars followed in travel west of Jupiter, four chi apart, both sharing the Tail degree, forming conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingyin, Mars passed in company west of Jupiter, four chi apart, both sharing the Tail degree in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 七年二月丙子，熒惑從行在填星西，相去二尺，同在牽牛度，爲合宿。

translations.literal: Year 7, second month, on bingzi, Mars followed in travel west of Saturn, two chi apart, both sharing the Lead Ox degree, forming conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 7, on bingzi, Mars passed in company west of Saturn, two chi apart, both sharing the Lead Ox degree in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，熒惑從在泣星西北七寸。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuwu, Mars followed seven cun northwest of the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuwu, Mars followed seven cun northwest of the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，熒惑從行入羽林。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Mars followed in travel and entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Mars passed in company into the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，熒惑逆入羽林。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuxu, Mars entered the Feathered Forest in retrograde.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu, Mars entered the Feathered Forest in retrograde.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，熒惑入羽林，成句己。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yichou, Mars entered the Feathered Forest, forming a gouji hook.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yichou, Mars entered the Feathered Forest and formed a gouji hook configuration.

sentences.zh: 八年四月丙申，熒惑從行入輿鬼，在西北星東南二寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Year 8, fourth month, on bingshen, Mars followed in travel and entered Chariot and Ghost, two cun southeast of the northwest star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 8, on bingshen, Mars passed in company into Chariot and Ghost two cun southeast of the northwest star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 十月乙亥，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yihai, Mars entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yihai, Mars entered Di.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，熒惑從入北落門，在第一星東南，去鉤鈐三寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei, Mars followed into the North Falling Gate, southeast of the first star, three cun from the Hook and Sickle, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, Mars followed into the North Falling Gate southeast of the first star, three cun from the Hook and Sickle, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 九年三月甲午，熒惑從在填星東七寸，在歲星南六寸，同在虛度，爲犯，爲合宿。

translations.literal: Year 9, third month, on jiawu, Mars followed, standing seven cun east of Saturn and six cun south of Jupiter, both sharing the Void degree—an encroachment and conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 9, on jiawu, Mars followed, standing seven cun east of Saturn and six cun south of Jupiter, all sharing the Void degree—an encroachment and conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 四月癸亥，熒惑從行入羽林。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on guihai, Mars followed in travel and entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guihai, Mars passed in company into the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 閏七月辛酉，熒惑從行在畢左股星西北一寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, on xinyou, Mars followed in travel at the left-thigh star of Net, northwest by one cun, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on xinyou, Mars passed in company at Net's left-thigh star, one cun to the northwest, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 八月十四日，熒惑應伏在昴三度，前先曆在畢度，二十一日始逆行北轉，垂及玄冬，熒惑囚死之時，而形色漸大於常。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day of the eighth month, Mars by the calendar should have been concealed at the third degree of Hairy Head; earlier it had stood by reckoning in the Net degree. On the twenty-first day it began retrograde motion turning north. As it approached deep winter—the time of Mars's prisoner-death—its color and form gradually grew larger than usual.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day of the eighth month Mars should have lain concealed at the third degree of Hairy Head, though by prior reckoning it had stood in the Net degree. On the twenty-first it turned retrograde northward; nearing deep winter—the season of Mars's prisoner-death—its hue and size slowly exceeded the norm.

translations.literal: Year 10, second month, on gengzi, Mars followed and entered the first star at the western head of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar, two cun to the west, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 10, on gengzi, Mars followed into the first star at the western end of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar, two cun west, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，熒惑從行入太微。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renyin, Mars followed in travel and entered Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, Mars passed in company into Taiwei.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月庚戌，熒惑從在填星西北六寸，爲犯，同在營室。

translations.literal: Year 11, second month, on gengxu, Mars followed, standing six cun northwest of Saturn, an encroachment, both sharing Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 11, on gengxu, Mars followed, standing six cun northwest of Saturn in Encampment, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，熒惑從行在歲星西南六寸，爲犯，同在婁度。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wuwu, Mars followed in travel six cun southwest of Jupiter, an encroachment, both sharing the Bond degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu, Mars passed in company six cun southwest of Jupiter at the Bond degree, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，熒惑從行入東井，在南轅西第一星東北一尺四寸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinsi, Mars followed in travel and entered the Eastern Well, one chi four cun northeast of the first star west of the southern crossbar.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, Mars passed in company into the Eastern Well, one chi four cun northeast of the first star west of the southern crossbar.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，熒惑逆行在五諸侯東星北四寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingsi, Mars in retrograde was at the eastern star of the Five Marquises, four cun to the north, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingsi, Mars in retrograde stood at the Five Marquises' eastern star, four cun north, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 隆昌元年三月乙丑，熒惑從行入輿鬼西北星東一寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Longchang 1, third month, on yichou, Mars followed in travel and entered Chariot and Ghost, one cun east of the northwest star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Longchang 1, on yichou, Mars passed in company into Chariot and Ghost one cun east of the northwest star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，熒惑從行在輿鬼積尸星東北七寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Mars followed in travel at Accumulated Corpses northeast of Chariot and Ghost by seven cun, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Mars passed in company at Accumulated Corpses seven cun northeast of Chariot and Ghost, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 閏三月甲寅，熒惑從入軒轅。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, on jiayin, Mars followed and entered Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, on jiayin, Mars followed into Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，熒惑從入太微，在右執法北二寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingyou, Mars followed and entered Taiwei, two cun north of the Right Law Administrator, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingyou, Mars followed into Taiwei two cun north of the Right Law Administrator, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 建元四年正月己卯，歲星太白俱從行，同在婁度爲合宿。

translations.literal: Jianyuan 4, first month, on jimao, Jupiter and Venus both followed in travel, sharing the Bond degree in conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jianyuan 4, on jimao, Jupiter and Venus both passed in company, sharing the Bond degree in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dingyou, Jupiter was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Jupiter appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 永明元年五月甲午，歲星入東井。

translations.literal: Yongming 1, fifth month, on jiawu, Jupiter entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongming 1, on jiawu, Jupiter entered the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 七月壬午，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on renwu, Jupiter was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renwu, Jupiter appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 三年五月丙子，歲星與太白合。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, on bingzi, Jupiter and Venus conjoined.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 3, on bingzi, Jupiter and Venus conjoined.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，歲星與辰星合。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinchou, Jupiter and Mercury conjoined.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou, Jupiter and Mercury conjoined.

sentences.zh: 十月己巳，歲星從入太微。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jisi, Jupiter followed and entered Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jisi, Jupiter followed into Taiwei.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，歲星從入太微，犯右執法。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiazi, Jupiter followed and entered Taiwei, encroaching upon the Right Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, Jupiter followed into Taiwei and encroached upon the Right Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 四年閏二月丙辰，歲星犯太微上將。

translations.literal: Year 4, intercalary second month, on bingchen, Jupiter encroached upon the supreme general of Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of year 4, on bingchen, Jupiter encroached upon Taiwei's supreme general.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，歲星犯太微上將。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengshen, Jupiter encroached upon the supreme general of Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, Jupiter encroached upon Taiwei's supreme general.

sentences.zh: 四月己未，歲星犯右執法。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jiwei, Jupiter encroached upon the Right Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiwei, Jupiter encroached upon the Right Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，歲星犯進賢，又與熒惑於軫度合宿。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yisi, Jupiter encroached upon Advance Worthies, and with Mars at the Chariot Shaft degree formed conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi, Jupiter encroached upon Advance Worthies and with Mars at the Chariot Shaft degree formed conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 五年二月癸卯，歲星犯進賢。

translations.literal: Year 5, second month, on guimao, Jupiter encroached upon Advance Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 5, on guimao, Jupiter encroached upon Advance Worthies.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，歲星晝見在軫度。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiazi, Jupiter was visible by day at the Chariot Shaft degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiazi, Jupiter appeared by day at the Chariot Shaft degree.

sentences.zh: 十月己未，歲星從在氐西南星北七寸，又辰星從入氐，在歲星西四尺五寸，又太白從在辰星東，相去一尺，同在氐度，三星爲合宿。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jiwei, Jupiter followed, standing seven cun north of Di's southwestern star; Mercury also followed into Di, four chi five cun west of Jupiter; Venus also followed east of Mercury, one chi apart, all sharing the Di degree—the three stars forming conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiwei, Jupiter followed, standing seven cun north of Di's southwestern star; Mercury also followed into Di four chi five cun west of Jupiter; Venus followed east of Mercury one chi away—all sharing the Di degree, the three stars in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiaxu, Jupiter was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Jupiter appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 六年三月甲申，歲星逆行入氐宿。

translations.literal: Year 6, third month, on jiashen, Jupiter entered Root in retrograde.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 6, on jiashen, Jupiter entered Root in retrograde.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，歲星晝見在氐度。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingyin, Jupiter was visible by day at the Di degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin, Jupiter appeared by day at the Di degree.

sentences.zh: 八年三月庚申，歲星守牽牛。

translations.literal: Year 8, third month, on gengshen, Jupiter stationed at Lead Ox.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 8, on gengshen, Jupiter held Lead Ox.

sentences.zh: 九年二月壬午，歲星從在填星西七寸，同在虛度爲合宿。

translations.literal: Year 9, second month, on renwu, Jupiter followed, standing seven cun west of Saturn, sharing the Void degree in conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 9, on renwu, Jupiter followed, standing seven cun west of Saturn at the Void degree in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 閏七月辛酉，歲星在泣星北五寸，爲犯，又守填星。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, on xinyou, Jupiter was five cun north of the Weeping Star, an encroachment, and also stationed at Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on xinyou, Jupiter stood five cun north of the Weeping Star, an encroachment, and also held Saturn.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，在泣星西一尺五寸，爲合宿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinmao, one chi five cun west of the Weeping Star, conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao, Jupiter stood one chi five cun west of the Weeping Star in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 永明元年六月，辰星從行入太微，在太白西北一尺。

translations.literal: Yongming 1, sixth month, Mercury followed in travel and entered Taiwei, one chi northwest of Venus.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Yongming 1, Mercury passed in company into Taiwei one chi northwest of Venus.

sentences.zh: 二年八月甲寅，辰星於翼犯太白。

translations.literal: Year 2, eighth month, on jiayin, Mercury at Wings encroached upon Venus.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 2, on jiayin, Mercury at Wings encroached upon Venus.

sentences.zh: 九年六月丙子，辰星隨太白於西方，在七星度，相去一尺四寸，爲合宿。

translations.literal: Year 9, sixth month, on bingzi, Mercury followed Venus in the west at the Seven Stars degree, one chi four cun apart, conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 9, on bingzi, Mercury followed Venus in the west at the Seven Stars degree, one chi four cun apart, in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月丙辰，辰星依曆應夕見西方亢宿一度，至九月八日不見。

translations.literal: Year 11, ninth month, on bingchen, Mercury by the calendar should have appeared at evening in the west in Kang's first degree; from the eighth day of the ninth month it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 11, on bingchen, Mercury by the calendar should have shown at evening in the west in Kang's first degree, but from the eighth day of the ninth month it was not seen.

sentences.zh: 隆昌元年正月丙戌，辰星見危度，在太白北一尺，爲犯。

translations.literal: Longchang 1, first month, on bingxu, Mercury was visible at the Rooftop degree, one chi north of Venus, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Longchang 1, on bingxu, Mercury appeared at the Rooftop degree one chi north of Venus, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 建元三年十月癸丑，填星逆行守氐。

translations.literal: Jianyuan 3, tenth month, on guichou, Saturn entered Root in retrograde and stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Jianyuan 3, on guichou, Saturn entered Root in retrograde and held it.

sentences.zh: 四年七月戊辰，填星從行入氐。

translations.literal: Year 4, seventh month, on wuchen, Saturn followed in travel and entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 4, on wuchen, Saturn passed in company into Di.

sentences.zh: 永明元年正月庚寅，填星守房心。

translations.literal: Yongming 1, first month, on gengyin, Saturn stationed at Room and Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yongming 1, on gengyin, Saturn held Room and Heart.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，填星逆行犯西咸星。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiazi, Saturn in retrograde encroached upon Western Sincerity Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi, Saturn in retrograde encroached upon Western Sincerity Star.

sentences.zh: 二年二月戊辰，填星犯東咸星。

translations.literal: Year 2, second month, on wuchen, Saturn encroached upon Eastern Sincerity Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 2, on wuchen, Saturn encroached upon Eastern Sincerity Star.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月辛巳，填星犯建星。

translations.literal: Year 4, twelfth month, on xinsi, Saturn encroached upon Establishment Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 4, on xinsi, Saturn encroached upon Establishment Star.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月戊辰，填星在須女度，又辰星從行在填星西南一尺一寸，爲合宿。

translations.literal: Year 7, twelfth month, on wuchen, Saturn was at the Girl degree; Mercury also followed in travel one chi one cun southwest of Saturn, conjoined lodging.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 7, on wuchen, Saturn stood at the Girl degree; Mercury also passed in company one chi one cun southwest of Saturn in conjoined lodging.

sentences.zh: 八年三月庚申，填星守哭尾。

translations.literal: Year 8, third month, on gengshen, Saturn stationed at Wailing Tail.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 8, on gengshen, Saturn held Wailing Star at the Tail degree.

sentences.zh: 九年七月庚戌，填星逆在泣西星東北七寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Year 9, seventh month, on gengxu, Saturn in retrograde stood seven cun northeast of the Weeping Star's western star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 9, on gengxu, Saturn in retrograde stood seven cun northeast of the Weeping Star's western star—an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 十月甲午，填星從行在泣星西北五寸，爲犯。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jiawu, Saturn, traveling in company, was five cun northwest of the Weeping Star, an encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiawu, Saturn passed in company five cun northwest of the Weeping Star, an encroachment.

sentences.zh: 流星災

translations.literal: Meteor calamities
translations.idiomatic: Calamities of shooting stars

sentences.zh: 建元元年十月癸酉，有流星大如三升塸，色白，尾長五丈，從南河東北二尺出，北行歷輿鬼西過，未至軒轅後星而沒，沒後餘中央，曲如車輪，俄頃化爲白雲，久乃滅。

translations.literal: Jianyuan year 1, tenth month, on guiyou, there was a meteor as large as a three-sheng dipper, white in color, with a tail five zhang long; it emerged two chi northeast of the South River, traveled north passing west of Chariot and Ghost, and vanished before reaching the rear star of Xuanyuan; after vanishing the remnant at the center curved like a wheel, and in a moment turned into white cloud, long before it faded.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyuan 1, tenth month, guiyou: a meteor the size of a three-sheng dipper, white, tail five zhang long, rose two chi northeast of the South River and ran north past the west of Chariot and Ghost. It vanished short of Xuanyuan's rear star; where it died the afterglow curled like a wheel-rim, then in a breath became white cloud and slowly faded.

sentences.zh: 流星自下而升，名曰飛星。

translations.literal: A meteor that rises from below is called a Flying Star.
translations.idiomatic: When a shooting star climbs from below, astronomers call it a Flying Star.

sentences.zh: 三年十月丙午，有流星大如月，赤白色，尾長七丈，西北行入紫宮中，光照牆垣。

translations.literal: Year 3, tenth month, on bingwu, there was a meteor as large as the moon, red-white in color, with a tail seven zhang long; it traveled northwest into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, its light illuminating the palace walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 3, on bingwu, a meteor as large as the moon, red-white, tail seven zhang long, streaked northwest into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure until its light lit the palace walls.

sentences.zh: 四年正月辛未，有流星大如三升塸，赤色，從北極第二星北一尺出，北行一丈而沒。

translations.literal: Year 4, first month, on xinwei, there was a meteor as large as a three-sheng dipper, red in color; it emerged one chi north of the North Pole's second star, traveled north one zhang, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 4, on xinwei, a meteor the size of a three-sheng dipper, red, rose one chi north of the North Pole's second star, ran north one zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，流星如鵝卵，從柳北出，入軒轅。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renzi, a meteor like a goose egg emerged north of Willow and entered Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi, a meteor the size of a goose egg rose north of Willow and entered Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 又一枚如瓜大，出西行沒空中。

translations.literal: Again one as large as a melon emerged, traveled west, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: Another, melon-sized, rose, ran west, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 永明元年六月己酉，有流星如二升椀，從紫宮出，南行沒氐。

translations.literal: Yongming year 1, sixth month, on jiyou, there was a meteor like a two-sheng bowl; it emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, traveled south, and vanished at Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Yongming 1, on jiyou, a meteor like a two-sheng bowl rose from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, ran south, and set at Di.

sentences.zh: 二年三月庚辰，有流星如二升椀，從天市中出，南行在心後。

translations.literal: Year 2, third month, on gengchen, there was a meteor like a two-sheng bowl; it emerged from the Celestial Market, traveled south behind Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 2, on gengchen, a meteor like a two-sheng bowl rose from the Celestial Market and ran south behind Heart.

sentences.zh: 四年二月乙丑，有流星大如一升器。

translations.literal: Year 4, second month, on yichou, there was a meteor as large as a one-sheng vessel.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 4, on yichou, a meteor the size of a one-sheng vessel appeared.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，有流星大如五升器。

translations.literal: On wuchen, there was a meteor as large as a five-sheng vessel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen a meteor the size of a five-sheng vessel appeared.

sentences.zh: 四月丁卯，有流星大如一升器，從南斗東北出，西行經斗入氐。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on dingmao, there was a meteor as large as a one-sheng vessel; it emerged northeast of the Southern Dipper, traveled west through the Dipper, and entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dingmao, a meteor the size of a one-sheng vessel rose northeast of the Southern Dipper, ran west through the Dipper, and entered Di.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，有流星大如鴨卵，從匏瓜南出，至虛而入。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingxu, there was a meteor as large as a duck egg; it emerged south of Gourd, reached Void, and entered.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu, a meteor the size of a duck egg rose south of Gourd, reached Void, and entered it.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，有流星大如三升塸，從觜星南出，西南行入天濛沒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinwei, there was a meteor as large as a three-sheng dipper; it emerged south of Turtle Beak, traveled southwest into Celestial Mist, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei, a meteor the size of a three-sheng dipper rose south of Turtle Beak, ran southwest into Celestial Mist, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，有流星大如二升塸，白色，從亢東北出，行入天市。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuyin, there was a meteor as large as a two-sheng dipper, white in color; it emerged northeast of Neck and traveled into the Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, a meteor the size of a two-sheng dipper, white, rose northeast of Neck and ran into the Celestial Market.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，有流星大如三升椀，白色，從天市帝座出，東北行一丈而沒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingsi, there was a meteor as large as a three-sheng bowl, white in color; it emerged from the Celestial Market's Imperial Seat, traveled northeast one zhang, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, a meteor the size of a three-sheng bowl, white, rose from the Celestial Market's Imperial Seat, ran northeast one zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 五年六月辛未，有流星大如三升器，沒後有痕。

translations.literal: Year 5, sixth month, on xinwei, there was a meteor as large as a three-sheng vessel; after vanishing a trail remained.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 5, on xinwei, a meteor the size of a three-sheng vessel appeared; after it vanished a mark remained.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，有流星大如四升器，白色，有光照地。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on bingshen, there was a meteor as large as a four-sheng vessel, white in color, with light that illuminated the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, a meteor the size of a four-sheng vessel, white, cast light upon the earth.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，西北有流星大如鴨卵，黃白色，尾長六尺，西南行一丈餘沒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi, in the northwest there was a meteor as large as a duck egg, yellow-white in color, with a tail six chi long; it traveled southwest more than one zhang and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi, a meteor the size of a duck egg, yellow-white, tail six chi long, appeared in the northwest, ran southwest more than one zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 六年三月癸酉，有流星大如鴨卵，赤色，無尾。

translations.literal: Year 6, third month, on guiyou, there was a meteor as large as a duck egg, red in color, without a tail.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 6, on guiyou, a meteor the size of a duck egg, red and tailless, appeared.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，北面有流星大如二升器，白色，北行六尺而沒。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on bingchen, in the north there was a meteor as large as a two-sheng vessel, white in color; it traveled north six chi and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingchen, a meteor the size of a two-sheng vessel, white, appeared in the north, ran north six chi, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 七月癸巳，有流星大如鵝卵，白色，從匏瓜南出，西南行一丈沒空中。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on guisi, there was a meteor as large as a goose egg, white in color; it emerged south of Gourd, traveled southwest one zhang, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guisi, a meteor the size of a goose egg, white, rose south of Gourd, ran southwest one zhang, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 須臾，又有流星大如五升器，白色，從北河南出，東北行一丈三尺沒空中。

translations.literal: In a moment, again there was a meteor as large as a five-sheng vessel, white in color; it emerged south of the North River, traveled northeast one zhang three chi, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: Moments later another meteor the size of a five-sheng vessel, white, rose south of the North River, ran northeast one zhang three chi, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 十月戊寅，南面有流星，大如雞卵，赤色，在東南行沒，沒後如連珠。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on wuyin, in the south there was a meteor as large as a chicken egg, red in color; it traveled southeast and vanished; after vanishing it was like strung pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuyin, a meteor the size of a chicken egg, red, appeared in the south, ran southeast, and vanished—its afterglow like strung pearls.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，有流星大如鵝卵，黃白色，尾長三丈，有光，沒後有痕從梗河出，西行一丈許，沒空中。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renyin, there was a meteor as large as a goose egg, yellow-white in color, with a tail three zhang long and light; after vanishing a trail remained; it emerged from Stem River, traveled west about one zhang, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renyin, a meteor the size of a goose egg, yellow-white, tail three zhang long and luminous, rose from Stem River, ran west about one zhang, and vanished in mid-sky, leaving a trail behind.

sentences.zh: 七年正月甲寅，有流星如五升器，白色，尾長四尺，從坐旗星出，西行入五車而過，沒空中。

translations.literal: Year 7, first month, on jiayin, there was a meteor like a five-sheng vessel, white in color, with a tail four chi long; it emerged from Sitting Flags, traveled west into the Five Chariots and passed through, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 7, on jiayin, a meteor like a five-sheng vessel, white, tail four chi long, rose from Sitting Flags, ran west through the Five Chariots, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，流星大如二升器，黃赤色，有光尾長六尺許，從亢南出，西行入翼中而沒，沒後如連珠。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dingchou, a meteor as large as a two-sheng vessel, yellow-red in color, with light and a tail about six chi long; it emerged south of Neck, traveled west into Wings and vanished; after vanishing it was like strung pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingchou, a meteor the size of a two-sheng vessel, yellow-red, luminous, tail about six chi long, rose south of Neck, ran west into Wings and vanished—its afterglow like strung pearls.

sentences.zh: 十月乙丑，有流星如三升器，赤黃色，尾長六尺，出紫宮內北極星，東南行三丈沒空中。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yichou, there was a meteor like a three-sheng vessel, red-yellow in color, with a tail six chi long; it emerged from the North Pole star within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, traveled southeast three zhang, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yichou, a meteor like a three-sheng vessel, red-yellow, tail six chi long, rose from the North Pole star inside the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, ran southeast three zhang, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，流星如三升器，白色，有光從五車北出，行入紫宮，抵北極第一第二星而過，落空中，尾如連珠，仍有音響似雷。

translations.literal: On renchen, a meteor like a three-sheng vessel, white in color and luminous, emerged north of the Five Chariots, traveled into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, passed the North Pole's first and second stars, fell in the void; its tail was like strung pearls, and still gave a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen a meteor like a three-sheng vessel, white and bright, rose north of the Five Chariots, entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, passed the North Pole's first and second stars, and fell in mid-sky—tail like strung pearls, with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 太史奏名曰「天狗」。

translations.literal: The Grand Astrologer memorialized, naming it "Heavenly Dog."
translations.idiomatic: The court astronomer reported it and named it the Heavenly Dog.

sentences.zh: 八年四月癸巳，有流星如二升器，黃白色，有光，從心星南一尺許出，南行二丈沒，沒後如連珠。

translations.literal: Year 8, fourth month, on guisi, there was a meteor like a two-sheng vessel, yellow-white in color and luminous; it emerged about one chi south of Heart, traveled south two zhang and vanished; after vanishing it was like strung pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 8, on guisi, a meteor like a two-sheng vessel, yellow-white and bright, rose about one chi south of Heart, ran south two zhang and vanished—its afterglow like strung pearls.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，流星如鵝卵，白色，長五丈許，從角星東北二尺出，西北行沒太微西蕃上將星閒。

translations.literal: On dingsi, a meteor like a goose egg, white in color, about five zhang long, emerged two chi northeast of Horn, traveled northwest and vanished between the supreme general stars of Taiwei's western rampart.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a meteor the size of a goose egg, white, some five zhang long, rose two chi northeast of Horn, ran northwest, and vanished between the supreme general stars of Taiwei's western rampart.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，有流星如鴨卵，赤色，從紫宮中出，西南行未至大角五尺許沒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on guiwei, there was a meteor like a duck egg, red in color; it emerged from within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, traveled southwest, and vanished about five chi short of Great Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiwei, a meteor the size of a duck egg, red, rose from within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, ran southwest, and vanished about five chi short of Great Horn.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申，有流星如五升器，赤白色，長七尺，東南行二丈，沒空中。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on wushen, there was a meteor like a five-sheng vessel, red-white in color, seven chi long; it traveled southeast two zhang and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wushen, a meteor like a five-sheng vessel, red-white, seven chi long, ran southeast two zhang and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 十月乙亥，有流星如鵝卵，白色，從紫宮中出，西北行三丈許，沒空中。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yihai, there was a meteor like a goose egg, white in color; it emerged from within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, traveled northwest about three zhang, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yihai, a meteor the size of a goose egg, white, rose from within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, ran northwest about three zhang, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，有流星如鵝卵，赤白色，有光無尾，從氐北一丈出，南行入氐中沒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei, there was a meteor like a goose egg, red-white in color, luminous and without a tail; it emerged one zhang north of Di, traveled south into Di, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, a meteor the size of a goose egg, red-white, bright and tailless, rose one zhang north of Di, ran south into Di, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，流星如鵝卵，白色，從參伐出，南行一丈沒空中。

translations.literal: On xinchou, a meteor like a goose egg, white in color, emerged from the punitive star of Shen, traveled south one zhang, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a meteor the size of a goose egg, white, rose from Shen's punitive star, ran south one zhang, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 又有一流星大如三升器，白色，從軫中出，東南行入婁中沒。

translations.literal: Again there was a meteor as large as a three-sheng vessel, white in color; it emerged from within Axletree, traveled southeast into Bond, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Another meteor the size of a three-sheng vessel, white, rose from within Axletree, ran southeast into Bond, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 九年五月庚子，有流星如雞子，白色，無尾，從紫宮裏黃帝座星西二尺出，南行一丈沒空中。

translations.literal: Year 9, fifth month, on gengzi, there was a meteor like a chicken egg, white in color and without a tail; it emerged two chi west of the Yellow Emperor's Seat star within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, traveled south one zhang, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 9, on gengzi, a meteor the size of a chicken egg, white and tailless, rose two chi west of the Yellow Emperor's Seat within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, ran south one zhang, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 丁未，流星如李子，白色，無尾，從奎東北大星東二尺出，東北行至天將軍而沒。

translations.literal: On dingwei, a meteor like a plum, white in color and without a tail, emerged two chi east of Striding Legs' northeastern great star, traveled northeast to the Celestial General and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei a meteor the size of a plum, white and tailless, rose two chi east of Striding Legs' northeastern great star, ran northeast to the Celestial General, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，流星如鵝卵，黃白色，尾長二丈，從箕星東一尺出，南行四丈沒。

translations.literal: On wushen, a meteor like a goose egg, yellow-white in color, with a tail two zhang long; it emerged one chi east of Winnowing Basket, traveled south four zhang, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen a meteor the size of a goose egg, yellow-white, tail two zhang long, rose one chi east of Winnowing Basket, ran south four zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 七月乙卯，西南有流星大如二升器，白色，無尾，西南行一丈餘沒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on yimao, in the southwest there was a meteor as large as a two-sheng vessel, white in color and without a tail; it traveled southwest more than one zhang and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yimao, a meteor the size of a two-sheng vessel, white and tailless, appeared in the southwest, ran southwest more than one zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 戊午，有流星如二升器，黃白色，有光從天江星西出，東北經天過入參中而沒，沒後如連珠。

translations.literal: On wuwu, there was a meteor like a two-sheng vessel, yellow-white in color and luminous; it emerged west of the Celestial River star, traveled northeast across the sky and passed into Shen, and vanished; after vanishing it was like strung pearls.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a meteor like a two-sheng vessel, yellow-white and bright, rose west of the Celestial River star, crossed the heavens northeast into Shen, and vanished—its afterglow like strung pearls.

sentences.zh: 閏七月戊辰，流星如鵝卵，赤色，尾長二尺，從文昌西行入紫宮沒。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, on wuchen, a meteor like a goose egg, red in color, with a tail two chi long; it emerged from Wenchang, traveled west into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on wuchen, a meteor the size of a goose egg, red, tail two chi long, rose from Wenchang, ran west into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，西南有流星如二升器，白色，西南行一丈沒。

translations.literal: On jisi, in the southwest there was a meteor like a two-sheng vessel, white in color; it traveled southwest one zhang and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi a meteor like a two-sheng vessel, white, appeared in the southwest, ran southwest one zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，有流星大如雞卵，白色，從少微星北頭出，東行入太微抵帝座星而過，未至東蕃次相一尺沒，如散珠。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wuzi, there was a meteor as large as a chicken egg, white in color; it emerged from the northern head of Lesser Auspicious, traveled east into Taiwei, passed the Imperial Seat star, and vanished one chi short of the eastern rampart's deputy minister star, like scattered pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi, a meteor the size of a chicken egg, white, rose from the northern head of Lesser Auspicious, ran east into Taiwei, passed the Imperial Seat, and vanished one chi short of the eastern rampart's deputy minister—scattering like pearls.

sentences.zh: 十年正月甲戌，有流星如五升器，白色，從氐中出，東南行經房道過，從心星南二尺沒。

translations.literal: Year 10, first month, on jiaxu, there was a meteor like a five-sheng vessel, white in color; it emerged from within Di, traveled southeast along the Road of Room and passed through, and vanished two chi south of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 10, on jiaxu, a meteor like a five-sheng vessel, white, rose from within Di, ran southeast along the Road of Room, and vanished two chi south of Heart.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，有流星如雞卵，青白色，尾長四尺，從牽牛南八寸出，南行一丈沒空中。

translations.literal: Third month, on guiwei, there was a meteor like a chicken egg, blue-white in color, with a tail four chi long; it emerged eight cun south of Lead Ox, traveled south one zhang, and vanished in the void.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei, a meteor the size of a chicken egg, blue-white, tail four chi long, rose eight cun south of Lead Ox, ran south one zhang, and vanished in mid-sky.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月壬寅，東北有流星如一升器，白色，無尾，北行三丈而沒。

translations.literal: Year 11, second month, on renyin, in the northeast there was a meteor like a one-sheng vessel, white, without tail, traveling north three zhang and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 11, on renyin, a white, tailless meteor the size of a one-sheng vessel appeared in the northeast, traveled north three zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申，有流星如三升器，白色，有光，尾長一丈許，從箕星東北一尺出，行二丈許，入斗度，沒空中，臨沒如連珠。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on bingshen, there was a meteor like a three-sheng vessel, white, with light, its tail about one zhang long; it emerged one chi northeast of the Winnowing Basket star, traveled about two zhang, entered the Dipper degree, and vanished in the sky; as it neared vanishing it was like linked pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingshen, a white meteor the size of a three-sheng vessel, luminous with a tail about one zhang long, emerged one chi northeast of the Winnowing Basket star, traveled some two zhang into the Dipper degree, and vanished in the sky—at the end like linked pearls.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，有流星大如雞子，黃白色，從太微端門出，無所犯，西南行一丈許沒，沒後有痕。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renshen, there was a meteor large as a chicken egg, yellow-white, emerging from Taiwei's End Gate, encroaching upon nothing, traveling southwest about one zhang and vanishing; after vanishing there was a trace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, a yellow-white meteor the size of a chicken egg issued from Taiwei's End Gate, made no encroachment, traveled southwest about one zhang and vanished, leaving a trace behind.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，有流星如雞子，赤色，無尾，從氐中出，西行一丈五尺沒空中。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on xinyou, there was a meteor like a chicken egg, red, without tail, emerging from Di, traveling west one chi five feet and vanishing in the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinyou, a red, tailless meteor the size of a chicken egg emerged from Di, traveled west one chi five feet, and vanished in the sky.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，有流星如雞卵，黃白色，從紫宮東蕃內出，東北行一丈五尺，至北極第五星西北四尺沒。

translations.literal: On wuyin, there was a meteor like a chicken egg, yellow-white, emerging from within the Purple Palace's eastern rampart, traveling northeast one chi five feet, reaching four chi northwest of the Northern Pole's fifth star and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a yellow-white meteor the size of a chicken egg emerged from within the Purple Palace's eastern rampart, traveled northeast one chi five feet, and vanished four chi northwest of the Northern Pole's fifth star.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，有流星如鴨卵，黃白色，從婁南一尺出，東行二丈沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yiyou, there was a meteor like a duck egg, yellow-white, emerging one chi south of Bond, traveling east two zhang and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiyou, a yellow-white meteor the size of a duck egg emerged one chi south of Bond, traveled east two zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，西南有流星如三升器，黃赤色，無尾，西南行三丈許沒，散如遺火。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou, in the southwest there was a meteor like a three-sheng vessel, yellow-red, without tail, traveling southwest about three zhang and vanishing, scattering like stray embers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, a tailless yellow-red meteor the size of a three-sheng vessel appeared in the southwest, traveled southwest about three zhang, vanished, and scattered like stray embers.

sentences.zh: 永元三年夜，天開黃色明照，須臾有物絳色如小甕，漸漸大如倉廩，聲隆隆如雷，墜太湖中，野雉皆雊，世人呼爲「木殃」。

translations.literal: At night in the third year of Yongyuan, heaven opened in yellow brightness and shone; presently there was a thing crimson like a small jar, gradually growing large as a granary, its sound rumbling like thunder; it fell into Lake Tai, wild pheasants all crowed, and people called it the "Wood Calamity."
translations.idiomatic: One night in Yongyuan year 3 the sky split open in yellow radiance; presently a crimson object like a small jar swelled until it was the size of a granary, roaring like thunder as it fell into Lake Tai. Wild pheasants all cried out, and people called it the "Wood Calamity."

sentences.zh: 史臣案《春秋》緯「天狗如大奔星，有聲，望之如火，見則四方相射」。

translations.literal: The historiographer notes: The Spring and Autumn Weft says, "The Heavenly Dog is like a great running star, has a sound, and when viewed is like fire; when it appears the four quarters shoot at one another."
translations.idiomatic: The compiler remarks: The Spring and Autumn Weft says, "The Heavenly Dog is like a great shooting star, with a sound; viewed, it is like fire; when it appears, the four quarters exchange volleys."

sentences.zh: 漢史云：「西北有三大星，如日狀，名曰天狗。

translations.literal: The Han History says: "In the northwest are three great stars, shaped like the sun, named the Heavenly Dog.
translations.idiomatic: The Han History says: "In the northwest are three great stars, sunlike in form, called the Heavenly Dog.

sentences.zh: 天狗出則人相食。

translations.literal: When the Heavenly Dog appears, people devour one another."
translations.idiomatic: When the Heavenly Dog appears, people devour one another."

sentences.zh: 」《天官》云：「天狗狀如大鏡星。

translations.literal: The Book of Heavenly Offices says: "The Heavenly Dog is shaped like the great Mirror Star."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Heavenly Offices says: "The Heavenly Dog is shaped like the great Mirror Star."

sentences.zh: 」又云：「如大流星，色黃，有聲。

translations.literal: It also says: "Like a great meteor, yellow in color, with a sound.
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Like a great meteor, yellow in color, with a sound.

sentences.zh: 其止地類狗所墜。

translations.literal: Where it stops on the ground resembles where a dog fell.
translations.idiomatic: Where it stops on the ground resembles where a dog fell.

sentences.zh: 望之如火光，炎炎衝天。

translations.literal: Viewed, it is like firelight blazing and rushing to the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Viewed, it is like blazing firelight rushing skyward.

sentences.zh: 其上銳，其下圓，如數頃田。

translations.literal: Above it is sharp, below round, like several qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Above it is sharp, below round, like several qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 見則流血千里，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: When seen, blood flows for a thousand li; armies are broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: When seen, blood flows for a thousand li; armies are broken and generals killed."

sentences.zh: 」《漢史》又云：「照明下爲天狗，所下兵起血流。

translations.literal: The Han History again says: "Illumination below is the Heavenly Dog; where it descends armies rise and blood flows."
translations.idiomatic: The Han History again says: "Illumination below is the Heavenly Dog; where it descends armies rise and blood flows."

sentences.zh: 」昭明，星也。

translations.literal: Zhaoming is a star.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoming is a star.

sentences.zh: 《洛書》云：「昭明見而霸者出。

translations.literal: The Luo Writ says: "When Zhaoming appears, hegemons emerge."
translations.idiomatic: The Luo Writ says: "When Zhaoming appears, hegemons emerge."

sentences.zh: 」《運斗樞》云：「昭明有芒角，兵徵也。

translations.literal: The Pivot of the Dipole says: "Zhaoming has rays and horns—a military omen."
translations.idiomatic: The Pivot of the Dipole says: "Zhaoming has rays and horns—a military omen."

sentences.zh: 」《河圖》云：「太白散爲天狗。

translations.literal: The River Chart says: "The Great White disperses as the Heavenly Dog."
translations.idiomatic: The River Chart says: "Venus disperses as the Heavenly Dog."

sentences.zh: 」《漢史》又云：「有星出，其狀赤白有光，即爲天狗，其下小無足，所下國易政。

translations.literal: The Han History again says: "When a star emerges, shaped red-white with light, it is the Heavenly Dog; below it is small and without feet; the state where it descends changes its government."
translations.idiomatic: The Han History again says: "When a star emerges red-white and luminous, it is the Heavenly Dog; below it is small and footless; the state where it falls changes its government."

sentences.zh: 」衆說不同，未詳孰是。

translations.literal: The many accounts differ; it is not yet clear which is correct.
translations.idiomatic: The many accounts differ; which is correct remains unclear.

sentences.zh: 推亂亡之運，此其必天狗乎。

translations.literal: Deducing the fortune of disorder and extinction, must this be the Heavenly Dog?
translations.idiomatic: Tracing the course of ruin and fall, must this indeed be the Heavenly Dog?

sentences.zh: 老人星

translations.literal: Old Man Star
translations.idiomatic: Old Man Star

sentences.zh: 建元元年十一月戊辰，老人星見南方丙上。

translations.literal: Jianyuan year 1, eleventh month, on wuchen, the Old Man Star appeared at bing on the south.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Jianyuan 1, on wuchen, the Old Man Star appeared at bing in the south.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，祠老人星。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on guimao, they sacrificed to the Old Man Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao, they sacrificed to the Old Man Star.

sentences.zh: 永明三年八月丁酉，老人星見南方丙上。

translations.literal: Yongming year 3, eighth month, on dingyou, the Old Man Star appeared at bing on the south.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Yongming 3, on dingyou, the Old Man Star appeared at bing in the south.

sentences.zh: 六年八月壬戌，老人星見南方丙上。

translations.literal: Year 6, eighth month, on renxu, the Old Man Star appeared at bing on the south.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 6, on renxu, the Old Man Star appeared at bing in the south.

sentences.zh: 七年七月壬戌，老人星見南方丙上。

translations.literal: Year 7, seventh month, on renxu, the Old Man Star appeared at bing on the south.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 7, on renxu, the Old Man Star appeared at bing in the south.

sentences.zh: 九年閏七月戊寅，老人星見南方丙上。

translations.literal: Year 9, intercalary seventh month, on wuyin, the Old Man Star appeared at bing on the south.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month of year 9, on wuyin, the Old Man Star appeared at bing in the south.

sentences.zh: 十年八月乙酉，老人星見。

translations.literal: Year 10, eighth month, on yiyou, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 10, on yiyou, the Old Man Star appeared.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月丙寅，老人星見南方丙上。

translations.literal: Year 11, ninth month, on bingyin, the Old Man Star appeared at bing on the south.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 11, on bingyin, the Old Man Star appeared at bing in the south.

sentences.zh: 白虹雲氣

translations.literal: White Rainbow and Cloud Qi
translations.idiomatic: White Rainbow and Cloud Qi

sentences.zh: 建元四年二月辛卯，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Jianyuan year 4, second month, on xinmao, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Jianyuan 4, on xinmao, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 永明十年七月癸酉，西方有白虹，須臾滅。

translations.literal: Yongming year 10, seventh month, on guiyou, in the west there was a white rainbow; presently it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Yongming 10, on guiyou, a white rainbow appeared in the west and soon vanished.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月甲午，西方有白虹，南頭指申，北頭指戌上，久久消滅。

translations.literal: Year 11, ninth month, on jiawu, in the west there was a white rainbow; its southern head pointed to shen, its northern head to xu above, and after a long while it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 11, on jiawu, a white rainbow in the west had its southern head at shen and its northern head at xu above; after a long while it vanished.

sentences.zh: 建元四年二月辛卯，黑氣大小二枚，東至卯，西至酉，廣五丈，久久消滅。

translations.literal: Jianyuan year 4, second month, on xinmao, black qi large and small in two pieces, east to mao and west to you, five zhang wide, and after a long while it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the same xinmao day in the second month of Jianyuan 4, black qi in two masses stretched from mao in the east to you in the west, five zhang wide, and after a long while vanished.

sentences.zh: 永明二年四月丁未，北斗第六第七星閒有一白氣。

translations.literal: Yongming year 2, fourth month, on dingwei, between the sixth and seventh stars of the Northern Dipper there was a white qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yongming 2, on dingwei, white qi lay between the Northern Dipper's sixth and seventh stars.

sentences.zh: 四年正月辛未，黃白氣長丈五尺許，入太微。

translations.literal: Year 4, first month, on xinwei, yellow-white qi about one chi five feet long entered Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 4, on xinwei, yellow-white qi about one chi five feet long entered Taiwei.

sentences.zh: 永明四年正月癸未，南面有陣雲一丈許。

translations.literal: Yongming year 4, first month, on guiwei, to the south there was a battle-array cloud about one zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yongming 4, on guiwei, a battle-array cloud about one zhang high appeared to the south.

sentences.zh: 五年四月己巳，有雲色黑，廣五尺，東頭指丑，西頭指酉，竝至地。

translations.literal: Year 5, fourth month, on jisi, there was cloud black in color, five chi wide; its eastern head pointed to chou and its western head to you, both reaching the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 5, on jisi, black cloud five chi wide had its eastern head at chou and its western head at you, both reaching the ground.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，東南有陣雲高一丈，北至卯，東南至巳，久久散漫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yisi, in the southeast there was a battle-array cloud one zhang high, north to mao and southeast to si; after a long while it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yisi, a battle-array cloud one zhang high in the southeast stretched north to mao and southeast to si; after a long while it dispersed.

sentences.zh: 六年二月癸亥，東西有一梗雲半天，曲向西，蒼白色。

translations.literal: Year 6, second month, on guihai, east and west there was a stake cloud half the sky, curving west, pale blue-white.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 6, on guihai, a pale blue-white stake cloud spanned half the sky from east to west, curving westward.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，南面有梗雲，黑色，廣六寸。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengchen, to the south there was a stake cloud, black, six cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengchen, a black stake cloud six cun wide appeared to the south.

sentences.zh: 七年十月辛未，有梗雲，蒼黑色，東頭至寅，西頭指酉，廣三尺，貫紫宮，久久消沒。

translations.literal: Year 7, tenth month, on xinwei, there was a stake cloud, blue-black; its eastern head reached yin and its western head pointed to you, three chi wide, piercing the Purple Palace; after a long while it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 7, on xinwei, a blue-black stake cloud three chi wide had its eastern head at yin and its western head at you, pierced the Purple Palace, and after a long while vanished.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月乙未，有梗雲，黑色，六尺許，東頭至卯，西頭至酉，久久散漫。

translations.literal: Year 8, eleventh month, on yiwei, there was a stake cloud, black, about six chi; its eastern head reached mao and its western head reached you; after a long while it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 8, on yiwei, a black stake cloud about six chi high stretched from mao in the east to you in the west; after a long while it dispersed.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，南面有陣雲，黑色，高一丈許，東頭至巳，西頭至未，久久散漫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengchen, to the south there was a battle-array cloud, black, about one zhang high; its eastern head reached si and its western head reached wei; after a long while it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, a black battle-array cloud about one zhang high to the south stretched from si in the east to wei in the west; after a long while it dispersed.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月丙辰，東面有梗雲，蒼白色，廣二尺三寸，南頭指巳至地，北頭指子至地，久久漸散漫。

translations.literal: Year 11, seventh month, on bingchen, to the east there was a stake cloud, pale blue-white, two chi three cun wide; its southern head pointed to si to the ground and its northern head to zi to the ground; after a long while it gradually dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 11, on bingchen, a pale blue-white stake cloud two chi three cun wide in the east had its southern head at si to the ground and its northern head at zi to the ground; after a long while it gradually dispersed.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：陽精火鏡，陰靈水存。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Yang essence is a fire mirror; yin spirit endures as water.
translations.idiomatic: In praise: the sun—a mirror forged of fire; the moon—a spirit that keeps to water.

sentences.zh: 有稟有射，代爲明昏。

translations.literal: Having reception and emission, generation after generation they become brightness and dusk.
translations.idiomatic: They receive and they shine forth, age upon age trading brightness for dusk.

sentences.zh: 垂光滿蓋，列景周渾。

translations.literal: Hanging light fills the canopy; arrayed images encircle the sphere.
translations.idiomatic: Their light drapes the vault of heaven; their forms stand ranked around the round sky.

sentences.zh: 具位臣輔，備象街門。

translations.literal: Positions fully filled, ministers and assistants; images complete at the Street Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Every station holds its minister-star; every sign stands ready at the Street Gate.

sentences.zh: 災生霣薄，祟起飛奔。

translations.literal: When disaster arises, falls are thin; when omens rise, they fly in rush.
translations.idiomatic: Disasters are born in thin falling fire; portents rise on wings that rush the sky.

sentences.zh: 弗忘人懼，瑜瑕辯論。

translations.literal: Do not forget people's fear; flaws and blemishes spark debate.
translations.idiomatic: Yet men's fear is not forgotten—every flaw in the jade sparks quarrel.

sentences.zh: 若任天道，竈亦多言。

translations.literal: If one entrusts to heaven's way, even the kitchen stove has much to say.
translations.idiomatic: Entrust all to Heaven's way, and even the kitchen god will have his say.

translations.idiomatic: [1] Endnote marker.
